name: m2
description: Amazon Web Services Mainframe Modernization provides tools and resources to help you plan and implement migration and modernization from mainframes to Amazon Web Services managed runtime environments.

subcommands.name: cancel-batch-job-execution
subcommands.description: Cancels the running of a specific batch job execution.

subcommands.name: create-application
subcommands.description: Creates a new application with given parameters.

subcommands.name: create-data-set-export-task
subcommands.description: Starts a data set export task for a specific application.

subcommands.name: create-data-set-import-task
subcommands.description: Starts a data set import task for a specific application.

subcommands.name: create-deployment
subcommands.description: Creates and starts a deployment to deploy an application into a runtime environment.

subcommands.name: create-environment
subcommands.description: Creates a runtime environment for a given runtime engine.

subcommands.name: delete-application
subcommands.description: Deletes a specific application.

subcommands.name: delete-application-from-environment
subcommands.description: Deletes a specific application from the specific runtime environment where it was previously deployed.

subcommands.name: delete-environment
subcommands.description: Deletes a specific runtime environment.

subcommands.name: get-application
subcommands.description: Describes the details of a specific application.

subcommands.name: get-application-version
subcommands.description: Returns details about a specific version of a specific application.

subcommands.name: get-batch-job-execution
subcommands.description: Gets the details of a specific batch job execution for a specific application.

subcommands.name: get-data-set-details
subcommands.description: Gets the details of a specific data set.

subcommands.name: get-data-set-export-task
subcommands.description: Gets the status of a data set import task initiated with the CreateDataSetExportTask operation.

subcommands.name: get-data-set-import-task
subcommands.description: Gets the status of a data set import task initiated with the CreateDataSetImportTask operation.

subcommands.name: get-deployment
subcommands.description: Gets details of a specific deployment with a given deployment identifier.

subcommands.name: get-environment
subcommands.description: Describes a specific runtime environment.

subcommands.name: get-signed-bluinsights-url
subcommands.description: Gets a single sign-on URL that can be used to connect to AWS Blu Insights.

subcommands.name: list-application-versions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the application versions for a specific application.

subcommands.name: list-applications
subcommands.description: Lists the applications associated with a specific Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-batch-job-definitions
subcommands.description: Lists all the available batch job definitions based on the batch job resources uploaded during the application creation.

subcommands.name: list-batch-job-executions
subcommands.description: Lists historical, current, and scheduled batch job executions for a specific application.

subcommands.name: list-batch-job-restart-points
subcommands.description: Lists all the job steps for a JCL file to restart a batch job.

subcommands.name: list-data-set-export-history
subcommands.description: Lists the data set exports for the specified application.

subcommands.name: list-data-set-import-history
subcommands.description: Lists the data set imports for the specified application.

subcommands.name: list-data-sets
subcommands.description: Lists the data sets imported for a specific application.

subcommands.name: list-deployments
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all deployments of a specific application.

subcommands.name: list-engine-versions
subcommands.description: Lists the available engine versions.

subcommands.name: list-environments
subcommands.description: Lists the runtime environments.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags for the specified resource.

subcommands.name: start-application
subcommands.description: Starts an application that is currently stopped.

subcommands.name: start-batch-job
subcommands.description: Starts a batch job and returns the unique identifier of this execution of the batch job.

subcommands.name: stop-application
subcommands.description: Stops a running application.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-application
subcommands.description: Updates an application and creates a new version.

subcommands.name: update-environment
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration details for a specific runtime environment.
